description: Claude wiring for the skill router, merge-review gate, plan-handoff gate, and the SessionStart behavioral-floor injector. Bash shell form selects the platform's Python 3 command while preserving quoted plugin paths.

hooks.command: plugin_root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then plugin_root="$(cygpath -u "$plugin_root")"; fi; exec bash "$plugin_root/hooks/run-claude-hook.sh" "$plugin_root/hooks/skill_router.py"

plugin_root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then plugin_root="$(cygpath -u "$plugin_root")"; fi; exec bash "$plugin_root/hooks/run-claude-hook.sh" "$plugin_root/hooks/merge_review_gate.py"

plugin_root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then plugin_root="$(cygpath -u "$plugin_root")"; fi; exec bash "$plugin_root/hooks/run-claude-hook.sh" "$plugin_root/hooks/model_routing_guard.py"

plugin_root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then plugin_root="$(cygpath -u "$plugin_root")"; fi; exec bash "$plugin_root/hooks/run-claude-hook.sh" "$plugin_root/hooks/plan_handoff_stop_launcher.py"

plugin_root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then plugin_root="$(cygpath -u "$plugin_root")"; fi; exec bash "$plugin_root/hooks/run-claude-hook.sh" "$plugin_root/hooks/session_floor.py"
